chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from one who informed him, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, concerning
a man from whom vermin fall while he is in the salat (prayer). He said: He continues in his salat, and that does not invalidate his wudu (ablution).

key_terms.الدَّوَابُّ: vermin or creeping creatures falling from the person
key_terms.يَمْضِي: he continues and proceeds without interruption

ai.seo_question: Does the falling of vermin from a person during salat invalidate wudu (ablution) or prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person in salat (prayer) from whom vermin fall. The Imam عليه السلام states that he should continue his salat and that this occurrence does not invalidate his wudu (ablution).
